Prerequisites: Favored Terrain (desert) class feature

The geomancer treats hot environments as though they were one step less severe; if she has a similar ability from another class feature, the benefits stack and she treats hot conditions as if they were two steps less severe. She needs to consume only half the normal amount of water for a creature of her size, and she gains a +4 bonus on Constitution checks to resist the effects of thirst. She also gains a +4 bonus on saving throws and checks to avoid becoming blinded or dazzled by glare or being deceived by a desert mirage.
